lines.text: Paul tells Timothy to be strong in the grace in Christ Jesus and entrust his teaching to faithful men.
Timothy is to join Paul in suffering like a good soldier, who avoids civilian affairs to please the one who enlisted him.
A competitor receives the crown only by competing according to the rules, and the hardworking farmer should be the last to partake of the crops.
Paul says Jesus Christ was raised from the dead and descended from Abraham, and Paul is chained like a criminal for this gospel.
If we endure, we will reign with Him, and if we are faithless, He remains faithful because He cannot deny Himself.
